description: Viewers accept Detective Anderson's probing actions (examining blueprints, dark hallways, fixtures) as standard detective procedure because of his official police persona.
The dramatic suspicion cast onto Dr. Wells and the hooded figure/gardener distracts viewers from scrutinizing the lead detective.
The stepladder examination in Scene 23 is staged as a search for hidden wires or art theft rather than a mechanical lever search, concealing its relevance until Dale operates the mantel in Scene 31.
